recorded.source: GenBank UZW58199.1 (plasmid), Sphingobium sp. JS3065; stored sequence verified byte-identical to that record (447 aa) on 2026-10-28. Functional basis: the 2023 Appl Environ Microbiol paper on 1-nitronaphthalene catabolism in this strain, identified as PMID:36622195, doi:10.1128/aem.01728-22 on 2026-11-13. The identifier was not invented: the GenBank record of this exact sequence (UZW58199.1) cites an unpublished manuscript by Li T, Xu J, Xu Z-J, Xu Y, Spain JC and Zhou N-Y on 1-nitronaphthalene catabolism in strain JS3065, and a PubMed query for that strain and compound returns exactly one record by those authors, the published version. The title changed between deposit and publication ('Molecular mechanism and evolution' to 'Molecular Basis and Evolutionary Origin'), so the match rests on authors, strain and compound rather than on the title. The DOI is registered in the handle registry. Substrate, product and reaction are UNCHANGED
